products.name: D95 Compensator for Glock Gen 5-6
products.short_description: Precision-machined compensator for Gen 5 & 6 Glocks, 1/2×28 thread. Black finish. Reduces muzzle rise and keeps you on target. Ships ready to install.
products.description:
Description 

The Defiant Machine Works D95 is designed to fit the contour of the Glock Gen 6 AND Gen 5 slides. The D95 was made in collaboration with Herrington Arms using their proven and effective comp design but adding our aestetic touch. The D95 will work with the stock springs provided your gun has gone through our recommended break in period of 500 rounds of factory new ammunition with the threaded barrel you intend to use with the firearm before installing a compensator. We’ve found that this compensator has a 34% muzzle flip reduction depending on what 9mm load and Glock model is used. 

Specifications

Material : 7075 Aluminum
Finish : Black Anodized
Compatibility : 
Models: Glock 17/19/26/45/34/19x/47 (including the MOS models of) with 1/2-28 Barrels and must be GEN 5 or GEN 6 Glocks
Included : 5/64 Allen key – Steel replacement 8-32 set screw
Length : 1.0″ long
Holster Compatibility : Will fit in most open bottom holsters. We use Tier 1 Concealed, and Safariland.
Will not work with aftermarket slides. 

Highlights

  • Designed to work with most 1/2-28 threaded 9mm barrels. 
  • Made from USA-sourced 7075 aluminum.
  • Designed, assembled, and machined in the USA.
  • 3 port design to mitigate vertical and felt recoil
  • NOT COMPATIBLE WITH SILENCERCO, BAR-STO, KKM, OR EFK BARRELS!
  • Works with all gen 5 and Gen 6 Glock 9mm models

AMMO DISCLAIMER: We DO NOT recommend using plated, bi-metal, or frangible ammo in ANY of our compensators. Doing so will void the warranty and we will not cover or replace the comp if there are any damages.

INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS

  • Make sure all threads are clean of grease, carbon, and loctite. Wipe the threads down till they’re clean. If the threads are not cleaned, the loctite will not set properly.
  • Only use loctite 243 on the barrel AND set screw threads. Some versions of the blue Loctite are not very strong and will not hold up. Feel free to use a generous amount.
  • Torque the set screws to no more than 18in/lbs.
  • Allow the loctite to set for 24-48 hours before using.
  • Please be sure that the compensator is not touching the slide, frame, or guide rod as that can cause cycling issues.

Restricted states: This product cannot be shipped to CA, NY, NJ, HI, IL, MD, MA, or WA.

products.name: Bodyguard 2.0 Viper Ports
products.short_description:
This precision machining upgrade is designed specifically for the Smith & Wesson Bodyguard 2.0 Standard model. Our custom Viper Ports are strategically cut into the slide and barrel to vent gases upward, significantly reducing muzzle rise and felt recoil. This helps keep your sights on target for faster follow-up shots, especially beneficial in the compact .380 ACP platform, where recoil can feel snappy.

Key Benefits:

  • Reduces muzzle flip and overall recoil for flatter shooting
  • Improves shot-to-shot recovery and control
  • Professional CNC machining for precise, consistent results
  • Maintains reliability with the factory recoil system
products.description:
Important Compatibility Notes:

  • For Standard Bodyguard 2.0 models only (with the non-ported, non-compensated barrel/slide setup).
  • Not for the Performance Center Carry Comp variant (longer ported barrel and different slide cuts).
  • Send-in service: Ship your slide, barrel, and related components for professional installation and finishing.

products.name: Smith & Wesson Bodyguard 2.0 Optic Cut
products.short_description:
This is our direct mill option for the Bodyguard 2.0. The RMSC optic footprint is the only footprint available due to the size constraints of the slide. This cut will fit standard micro pistol optics such as the Holosun 407k/507k, Vortex Defender CCW, Sig Romeo Zero, and others in the RMSC pattern.
The Standard Bodyguard 2.0 Optic Cut features precision milling directly into the slide, leaving threaded posts for mounting your optic to ensure a secure, tight fit and long-term reliability. Please note: this milling option will remove the factory rear iron sight.
The Carry Comp Bodyguard 2.0 Optic Cut features precision-milled interlocking pockets with custom-fitted wedges, machined to match the cut’s depth, secured by two screws each. This design accommodates the thinner Carry Comp Bodyguard Slide compared to the Standard Bodyguard. The wedges are preinstalled, torqued to specification with red Loctite, and do not require removal for slide disassembly. Note: This milling option removes the factory rear iron sight.

Disassembly of the slide is not required, just remove it from the frame to ship. All the hardware needed to mount your optic will be included.

*Optic screws are included for all optic cuts except the DPP footprint.*

products.name: The Tiger Shark
products.short_description:
The P365 is a shop favorite for EDC, though we knew we could make improvements. Aesthetically, it leaves something to be desired. Adding serrations upfront aids slide manipulation and gives it a more lowing look. On top of that, we added diamond checkering for a little extra bite when doing press checks….it also looks cool. We kept the sides less aggressive so you don’t scratch that $175 holster you just bought.

“Take a bite out of the mundane.”

SPECIAL NOTES:

  • We cannot Optic Cut slides that already have factory optic mounting solutions (Optic Ready M&P, MOS, etc.).
  • Optics will be moved as far back as possible when selecting Front or Delete BUIS.
  • Top serrations will be adjusted to fit on XMacros.

______________________________

*LEADTIME GUARANTEE* 

All optic cuts will be completed within 2 weeks of receiving them. If not, we will refund 30% of your order.

products.name: Saber OEM Slide Mill
products.short_description:
The Saber slide mill came about from wanting an affordable OEM mill that reduced weight on the slide for EDC while maintaining the reliability and cleanliness of an OEM gun. We know you are working and doing life with your firearm on your body and don’t always want that lint and sweat getting into massive holes milled into your slide, much less dirt and debris when you are shooting it.

Keep it simple. Keep it effective.

Disclaimer—This is an OEM slide milling package for a customer-supplied slide. After placing the order, you will receive email instructions on shipping your slide to us.

OPTIC CUT 17/19x/19/45/47/34 SPECIAL NOTES:

  • Due to design constraints, the GLOCK 41 cannot be milled.
  • Optics will be moved as far back as possible when selecting Front or Delete irons.
  • We cannot Optic Cut slides that already have factory optic mounting solutions (MOS).

OPTIC CUT 43/43x/48 SPECIAL NOTES:

  • Optics will be moved as far back as possible when selecting Front or Delete irons.
  • We cannot optic cut slides that already have optic mounting solutions (MOS).
  • If selecting  MOS Rear Stud Delete, this cut deletes rear MOS studs to allow direct mounting of K Series/EPS carry optic.

products.name: Genesis OEM Slide Mill
products.short_description:
We designed the Genesis slide with the modern shooter in mind. We wanted milling that provided aggressive texturing up front to help with manipulating the slide but not something that would tear up your holster or hands. We also added the matching texture to the rear of the slide in case you aren’t running an optic and prefer to manipulate the slide from the rear. With windows on all three sides of the slide, we have reduced weight to help with felt recoil and allow the option for barrel ports. We also think it looks cool, but we might be slightly biased.

Disclaimer—This is an OEM slide milling package for a customer-supplied slide. After placing the order, you will receive email instructions on shipping your slide to us.

products.name: Slide Only Cerakote
products.short_description:
Customize your pistol slide with Cerakote. 

Every slide is prepped, coated, and oven-cured in house in Clarksville, TN, nothing gets sent out. We’ve coated a lot of slides, and every one gets the same careful prep and clean finish we’d want on our own guns.

Why Cerakote

  • Much tougher than spray paint, Duracoat, or most factory finishes
  • Protects against rust, holster wear, and daily carry abuse
  • Goes on thin, so it won’t mess with how your slide fits or runs
  • Dozens of colors, plus battleworn and camo options

How it works

  1. Pick your coating and colors and place your order
  2. We email you shipping instructions
  3. Send in your slide
  4. We prep, coat, and cure it
  5. It ships back to you

Check out our Cerakote Gallery Here – https://defiantmachineworks.com/cerakote-camos/
